info.name: AgriMap Complete API
info.description:
Complete API collection for AgriMap (dual backend).

DJANGO backend (AI/geospatial, source of truth): {{django_base_url}} (local http://localhost:8002, prod https://agri-map-v81v.onrender.com)
NODE backend (finance/monetization — loans, carbon-credit tokenization, wallet, payments, chatbot, subscriptions, webhooks): {{node_base_url}} (local http://localhost:3001)

Auth: Django issues SimpleJWT (username+password). Login stores access->{{auth_token}}, refresh->{{refresh_token}} via test scripts on login/refresh/register.
Flow: Register/Login -> create farmer profile -> create field (copy id->{{field_id}}) -> satellite fetch/process -> analysis/soil/carbon/reports. Cooperative flow: create coop (id->{{cooperative_id}}) -> add member (id->{{member_id}}).

Sections prefixed 🟢 Django match server-agri-map-django/urls.py + smoke_tests.py exactly. Remaining sections target the Node backend.

request.description: Django RegisterSerializer: username, email, password(min 8). Returns {user, access, refresh}.
SimpleJWT TokenObtainPairView: username + password. Returns {access, refresh}.
Creates Farmer linked to request.user. Fields: phone, location.
Requires user_id of a user WITH a farmer profile. role: member|admin. Creator or admin only.
geometry must be valid GeoJSON with type+coordinates. area_ha optional.
field_id required (must be owned). date_range optional [start,end] date strings.
Requires >=1 fetched image for the field, else 400.
All fields optional (defaults shown). Ranges enforced: N/P/K 0-300, temp -10..55, humidity 0-100, rainfall 0-5000, moisture 0-100, lon/lat. Empty {} also valid (uses defaults).
404 if no BoundaryDetection row for field.
404 if no VegetationIndex rows for field.
404 if no LandDegradation row for field.
404 if no SoilHealthRecord for field. No POST — records come from satellite processing pipeline.
404 if no CarbonSequestration row for field.
Aggregates crop, soil, carbon, vegetation for the field.
